survey: Upright locker cabinet with rounded edges, seen from the front-left; the front opening and the left side wall (two groups of three vent slots) are visible. It stands on four short feet: three are visible and the fourth is hidden at the back right. All visible feet touch the floor. A single door is open on the right, attached along the right edge of the opening where a real locker's hinge line would be (hinges not drawn, an acceptable simplification). It shows its outer face almost flat to the camera, with two vent groups and a keyhole latch on the free edge, and matches the opening in height and width. Inside, a shelf runs across the full width near the top and holds standing and lying books. Below it, a clothes rail spans from the left inner wall to the right one, with a mounting cap on the right end. On the floor of the locker, a basketball rests on a pair of sneakers. All parts are supported; no thin parts were flagged as loose ends.
